_comment: The diner on Main Street (street.json, whose model, ground, lights and glow it shares): the racing hub's Diner drives
here. The positions are the street's (see street.json): x along Main Street, z across it, the diner's side towards -z.
The lot is x -18 to 18, z -9 to -39, the diner's front at z = -39. Two rows of bays (lines every 3 m from x = -15 to
15, 5 m deep) face the diner: one along its front (the racers'), one from z = -15 to -20 (the player's), an aisle in
front of it. Headings are degrees, 0 facing +z, 180 facing the diner.
arrive: down the street in the lane on the diner's side from the east, right into the lot and nose first into the
player's bay; the car stops at the last point. backOut: out of the bay backwards, its nose swinging west. leave:
from where it backed out to, across the lot and right onto the street, westwards; the screen goes before it ends.
lookWhileParked: where the driver looks in the bay, degrees from straight ahead, to the left positive; lookUpWhileParked:
how far up, degrees (the diner's sign is over the windscreen's top), -15 to 15.
bays: where the racers at the diner have parked, in the order they are filled.
model, sun, lights, glow, credit: left out, the street's.
